common.import_reason_chip_actions: The new card uses its own click and hold actions for chips. The old choice between single and double click has no direct equivalent.
common.import_reason_subtitle: The new cards do not use the old card’s freely formatted HTML subtitle. Their title and status area follows the new layout.
common.import_reason_chip_geometry: Chip width and text size follow the new card’s layout. The old pixel values are not mapped directly.
common.import_reason_title_size: The new cards use a consistent title style. The old individual title-size value is not copied directly.
common.import_reason_chip_scopes: Chips now come from global, list-type, list and browser scopes. The old merge order is not automatically translated to this model.
common.import_reason_important_chips: The new system manages highlighted chips as important chips per list. The old word list is not automatically converted to these markings.
common.import_reason_category_dialog: The new card uses its own add and edit dialogs. The old yes/no option for the category prompt is not copied one-to-one.
common.import_reason_html_export: The old HTML/offline export is currently absent from the new cards. Its old button option therefore has no direct equivalent.
common.import_reason_pdf_export: PDF export exists in the new cards. The importer does not yet map the old option name automatically; the PDF button can be configured in the card editor.
common.import_reason_share_button: The new share/send function uses its own card options and notification profiles assigned in the backend. The old switch is not copied automatically.
common.import_reason_browser_chips: Browser chips exist only in the individual browser and are not part of the card YAML. They are not imported; their use is configured separately in the new cards.
common.import_reason_ean_data: The old EAN To-do database is imported only when explicitly selected for an inventory import. Local EAN files are not imported.
common.import_reason_ean_display: The new card uses the integration’s product database for search and product information. The old EAN-list suggestion and badge settings are not copied directly.
common.import_reason_product_quantity: The new system stores and displays package quantity separately from the product name. The old EAN option for appending quantity is not mapped automatically.
common.import_reason_scanner: Scanners and their targets are managed centrally in the backend. Importing does not configure the old card’s MAC-address assignment.
common.import_reason_scanner_actions: The old removal mode on the Add button is not copied. Booking mode and scanner actions are configured in the new inventory interface and backend.
common.import_reason_notifications: Notification services, targets and triggers are now configured through per-list profiles in the backend. Importing does not create or enable these assignments.
common.import_reason_scripts: The script and triggering events are selected per list in the backend. The old card connection is not configured or executed automatically.
common.import_reason_inventory_controls: The new inventory card has its own initial-action and timeout options. The old option names are not mapped to these settings automatically.
common.import_reason_inventory_groups: The simplified inventory import combines same-name variants in the same category into one stock entry. Old variant groups and group minimum stocks are not created.
common.import_reason_dynamic_categories: The new list uses its own model for saved and dynamic categories. The old on/off switch is not copied; categories on imported entries are retained.
common.import_reason_category_scopes: Categories from the YAML are saved for the new list. The old combination of card, file and dynamic categories is not automatically translated to the new scopes and sorting options.
common.import_reason_category_chips: Category chips are available in the new card with their own layout choice. The old switch is not mapped automatically; select the layout in the card editor.
common.import_reason_capitalization: The new list preserves the saved spelling of names. The old card’s automatic capitalization is not copied as a setting.
common.import_reason_category_text_color: Category background color is imported. A separate old text color is not mapped; the new layout determines its own text color.
common.import_reason_custom_styles: Custom CSS from the old card is not executed or copied to the new cards. It targets the old HTML structure; the new card uses its own layout.
common.import_reason_camera_inventory: The new inventory card provides camera scanning through its own card option. The old QR-button setting is not mapped to it automatically; the new card’s default applies.
common.import_reason_camera_other: The old QR list-import button has no direct equivalent in this new card type. Centrally managed barcode scanners are configured separately in the backend.
common.import_reason_input_mask: The old option for hiding the input area is not mapped directly for this card type. Input display follows the new card’s layout.
common.import_reason_descriptions: The new card distinguishes description text from product details. The old description switch is not mapped automatically here; the new card’s default applies.
common.import_reason_category_display_inventory: The new inventory card has its own category-grouping switch. The three old display modes are not copied one-to-one; choose the layout in the card editor.
common.import_reason_category_display: This new card type displays categories using its own grouping. The old modes for hiding category headings are not copied directly.
common.import_reason_unmapped: The importer does not yet have an automatic mapping for this old setting. The new card’s default applies. This does not automatically mean the related feature is absent.
common.import_reason_unknown_note: This note does not yet have a specific import explanation. Check the preview before importing.
common.import_reason_chip_position: The old “auto_panel” position becomes “auto”. The new card places the chip area according to the available space.
common.import_reason_font_range: The new card allows entry text sizes from 12 to 24 pixels. An old value outside this range is adjusted to the nearest limit.
common.import_reason_inventory_selected: The YAML does not specify a mode. Inventory was explicitly selected for this import, so entries are processed as stock.
common.import_reason_unsupported_mode: This card mode is not one of the supported import types and is skipped. Other recognized cards remain in the preview.
common.import_reason_inventory_simple: Imported inventory items receive new basic products without EANs. EAN assignments, variant groups, minimum stocks and automatic replenishment are deliberately excluded.
common.import_reason_inventory_merged: When EAN import is enabled, entries linked to the same EAN are combined. Entries without an EAN are combined by name and category. Stock is added once from each original entry.
common.import_reason_inventory_visibility: A combined item includes visible and hidden entries. The new item remains visible and its stock includes all combined quantities.
common.import_reason_inventory_description: Free-form descriptions are not copied by the simplified inventory import. It copies only name, stock and category; the source-list description remains unchanged.
common.import_reason_transfers: The old transfer queues and their transfer rules are excluded from this import. Automatic replenishment is configured separately in the backend afterwards.

help.legend_collapsible: Combines reference lines, point symbols, and data series in one collapsible legend. Its state is saved per card in this browser.
help.monthly_due_warning: Marks a task with a monthly repeat interval as due soon when this much time remains. Enter minutes: 60 = 1 hour, 1,440 = 1 day, 10,080 = 1 week.
help.nonrepeating_due_warning: Marks a task without a repeat interval as due soon when this much time remains. Enter minutes: 60 = 1 hour, 1,440 = 1 day, 10,080 = 1 week.
help.local_data_bring_sync: All information comes from local storage. Bring! items are synced through the linked Home Assistant list.
help.todo_category_order: General comes first. Categories are then sorted alphabetically, by source, or by their saved position.
help.history_independent_storage: Permanently store selected Home Assistant states independently of Recorder.
help.chips_auto_position: Automatic places chips on the right in panel and large views, and below the list otherwise. On narrow cards, they are always at the bottom.
help.initial_plain_chips_limit: Limits the initial view of plain chips. At 0, all plain chips start collapsed. This setting has no effect on category chips.
help.notification_open_path: For a Companion app target, a relative path opens the corresponding Home Assistant page. Other notification targets do not support this option.
help.todo_chip_due_tomorrow: Clicking the chip makes the new item due on the following calendar day. A time is optional.
help.replace_chip_scope: Replacing deletes the existing chip and moves this chip to the new scope with the selected settings.
help.entity_name_override: Overrides the entity display name in the card header.
help.restock_to_minimum: The transferred quantity is the minimum minus current stock. Example: stock 5, minimum 6 → 1 item.
help.stock_display_position: Determines whether current stock appears beside the item name or between the plus and minus buttons.
help.inventory_chip_color_source: Determines whether saved chip colors or the colors for Global, Inventory, and this list are used. Browser chips use the browser chip color in all colored modes.
help.inventory_action_button: Shows the large button for the active transaction mode. Entries can still be processed through suggestions, chips, EAN, and Enter.
help.show_effective_chips: Shows or hides the quick entries available for this list.
help.disabled_scanner_events: Disabled scanner events are logged but do not change stock.
help.fixed_default_without_quantity: The list default is “Fixed quantity”, but no default quantity is set. Automatic restocking for {p0} will therefore only occur once “Fixed quantity” is selected here and a quantity is set.
help.zero_stock_restock_scan: The scan remains a withdrawal without changing stock and adds the scanned quantity to the target shopping list.
help.scan_pending_save: The scan was recorded. The stock change is only applied when you save. Closing leaves the scan under “Pending scans”.
help.category_sort_position: The first position is 1. Inserting automatically shifts subsequent categories. Use “Edit order” to set a combined order of global and list-specific categories.
help.manage_product_categories: Manage global, list-type, and list-specific product categories under “Products” in the administration area.
help.product_category_scope: The category is saved as the product default in the displayed scope: Global, Shopping lists, or This list. Existing shopping items remain unchanged. Checking the box also moves this shopping item. Dynamic categories must first be saved permanently. Categories with the same name are merged. Priority increases from left to right: Global → Shopping lists → This list.
help.tandoor_credentials: Credentials are stored only in the backend. Tandoor can then be enabled individually in the settings of local shopping lists.
help.shopping_type_chips: These chips are available in all shopping lists with list-type chips enabled.
help.base_category_order: This base order automatically applies to all lists without a custom combined order.
help.todo_type_categories: These categories are available to all task lists with list-type categories enabled.
help.global_categories: These categories are available to all lists with global categories enabled.
help.inventory_type_labels: These labels are available to all inventory lists with list-type labels enabled.
help.custom_combined_order: This list uses its own combined order. Changes to the base orders will apply here again only after resetting.
help.scanner_test_workflow: This test feature remains available permanently and uses the same backend workflow as a real scan.
help.chip_mark_important: This chip can be marked as important for this list.
help.dynamic_category_not_default: Dynamic category – not saved as a product default.
help.scanner_history_sources: Real and simulated scanner events appear together in this history.
help.own_item_chips: This list’s own item chips are always available. To-do templates are never shown here.
help.inventory_single_group: An item can belong to only one group. Items from another group are moved when saving.
help.dish_ingredients: A dish combines several ingredients that can later be added to a shopping list together or individually.
help.restock_rule_precedence: An item or group’s own rule takes precedence over this list default. “No automatic restocking” explicitly disables it there. Groups are transferred using their group name; the shopping list shows their product variants to help with selection.
help.dynamic_category_origin: A category appears here once a list item uses it and it has not yet been saved permanently.
help.ingredient_lines: One ingredient per line. Add a quantity in parentheses, for example “Tomatoes (2)”. Lines not yet applied are automatically used as ingredients when saving.
help.backend_list_types: Shopping, Bring!, task, and inventory lists in the backend.
help.title_collapse: Allows the card content to be expanded and collapsed using its title. This setting has no effect with “Only in large view”.
help.browser_chip_save_action: Enables “Save permanently to this list” in a browser chip’s menu. Press and hold the browser chip to open the menu.
help.persistent_notification: Creates a message in the Home Assistant notification area. It remains there until dismissed and supports text and Markdown.
help.available_todo_lists: Only to-do lists provided by HA List Manager are offered.
help.title_icon_color: Sets the color of the icon to the left of the title. If none is selected, the Home Assistant theme’s primary color is used.
help.todo_search_filter: Filters visible tasks by name, description, category, and label as you type. Adding and Enter remain available.
help.offer_global_categories: Also offer categories created for all lists.
help.offer_shared_quick_actions: Also offer shared quick actions for shopping and inventory lists.
help.history_sample_storage: Stores the state, attributes, and timestamp of every new HA update, even when the value is unchanged. Nothing is recorded during Home Assistant startup.
help.history_axis_decimals: Applies only to labels and the smallest possible uniform tick interval on the left chart axis.
help.inventory_category_grouping: Groups inventory items into collapsible categories. Off shows one flat list.
help.select_saved_categories: Only categories already saved under “Categories” can be selected here.
help.link_inventory_product: Links a product from the product database to this inventory list. If it does not exist yet, “Record new product” first saves it in the product database and then selects it. Search shows at most 100 results.
help.bring_quantity_parsing: In Bring!, this becomes “2 x 250 ml”, for example. Entries such as “250 ml”, “2 x 250 ml”, and “2 x Organic, mild” are automatically split when read.
help.category_chip_layouts: “No category chips” shows plain quick entries. The other options group products by category; “Side by side (compact)” omits the count and expand arrow.
help.list_labels_precedence: This list’s labels are always available. Definitions with the same name are resolved using the same fixed rule.
help.item_divider_spacing: Sets the space between an item’s content and the divider below it. Default is 10 px.
help.divider_item_spacing: Sets the space between the divider or category row and the next item. Default is 10 px. When dividers are hidden, both values together determine the space between items.
help.item_category_base_size: Sets the shared base size of item and category names. Details and labels are automatically shown smaller.
help.recipe_ingredient_search_default: Sets the default state of the “Search ingredients” checkbox in recipe search.
help.shopping_quantity_position: Sets whether the quantity appears before or after the item name, or between the plus/minus buttons.
help.history_initial_view: Sets which view is active when the card loads.
help.list_content_view: Sets where the list content appears. Use the title icon to open and close the large view; Esc also closes it. With “Only in large view”, clicking the title also opens the list.
help.selected_product_default: The effective product default appears here after selecting a product.
help.notification_target_types: Notify entities send to a device or a connected service. Persistent messages appear in the Home Assistant notification area.
help.append_brand_if_missing: Only if the brand is not already in the original product name.
help.default_list_icon: If no custom icon is set, the appropriate icon for the list type is used automatically.
help.inventory_category_override: Product default: “{p0}”. Selecting or entering a category here overrides it only in this inventory. Clearing restores the product default. New dynamic categories can be saved permanently later in category management. Use “Edit item” to change the product default.
help.scanner_dynamic_default: Scanners with dynamic assignment then use the default target from settings.
help.inventory_group_variants: Variants share a group name and a common minimum stock level.
help.large_due_category_icon: Enlarges the category icon when due information appears below it.
help.shopping_category_chip_color: Uses the category color for all quick entries within that category. When disabled, the color display and scope colors set below apply. “No colors” keeps quick entries neutral even when this option is enabled.
help.shopping_add_dialog_behavior: Existing list items increase their quantity. “Always” asks for the quantity to add. “Never” initially places new items under General.
help.history_header_value_entity: Selects exactly one of up to five entities for the current value at the top right, or hides the value completely.
help.todo_template_due_rules: You can configure additional rules such as “today”, “tomorrow”, an offset, or the next selected weekday later in the backend under Chips & Templates → To-do templates.
help.global_chip_color: Used for chips from the global scope.
help.list_chip_color: Used for chips that apply only to this list.
help.browser_chip_color: Used for chips saved only in this browser. “No colors” also keeps browser chips neutral.
help.history_time_range_fallback: Used when no fixed number of latest readings is specified.
help.shopping_important_chips: Shows chips marked as important first, or additionally under “Important” when grouped by category. Press and hold a chip to set or clear its importance for this list.
help.shopping_quantity_buttons: Shows buttons on each item to increase or decrease its quantity directly.
help.todo_template_visibility: Shows only task templates available for this to-do list. General item chips are never shown.
help.chips_filter_as_typing: Shows only chips whose names contain the entered text as you type.
help.inventory_category_toggle: Shows the button that expands or collapses all visible categories together.
help.inventory_stock_filter: Shows the filter for stock 0, stock 0–1, and minimum stock levels.
help.history_card_description: Shows the independently stored history of up to five Home Assistant entities.
help.shopping_button_bar_position: Shows the button bar with the category toggle and “Delete completed” above or below the item list.
help.todo_input_row_position: Shows the input row above or below the tasks.
help.inventory_mode_controls: Shows the mode selector with Add stock, Remove stock, Record, and Correct, and its toggle in the card header.
help.todo_description_visibility: Shows the optional task description below its name.
help.todo_label_visibility: Shows assigned labels below the task. Hiding them does not remove assignments.
help.inventory_pdf_action: Shows the action to download the entire inventory as a PDF in the card header or three-dot menu.
help.shopping_category_counts: Shows the number of completed items and the total number of items in the category header.
help.shopping_quantity_input: Shows a field in the input row for the quantity of new items or items to add.
help.history_view_buttons: Shows two small buttons for chart and list above the content.
help.chip_picker_icon: Shows a subtle chip icon on the right of the item field. It opens all available chips, even when the normal chip display is hidden or collapsed.
help.history_numeric_attribute: Shows a numeric attribute instead of the state. Use dots to specify nested attributes.
help.todo_item_dividers: Shows a horizontal divider between tasks.
help.legend_initially_collapsed: Initial setting used until a legend state for this card has been saved in the browser.
help.hourly_due_warning: Tasks with an hourly interval are marked as due soon within this time. Enter minutes: 10 = 10 minutes, 60 = 1 hour, 1,440 = 1 day.
help.content_enablement: Enable or disable global content and content for specific list types directly.
help.shopping_category_order: General comes first. Set the manual order in category management for this list.
help.restock_rules_only: Automatic restocking only applies to items and groups with their own restock rule.
help.card_layout_auto: Automatic adjusts the layout to the dashboard and available card width. Panel and mobile views can enforce a fixed layout.
help.template_layout_auto: Automatic shows templates on the right in wide panel and large views, and below narrow cards.
help.history_decimal_places: Limits decimal places in the card header, legend and chronological list.
help.history_scroll_limit: With more entries, the chronological list gets its own scroll area.
help.chip_due_today: Clicking the chip makes the new entry due on the current calendar day. A time is optional.
help.next_weekday: Example: “Monday” always means the next upcoming Monday, not today.
help.pending_shopping_quantity: The quantity already pending on the shopping list is shown for information only and is never deducted.
help.inventory_card_title: Overrides the name in the card header. Leave empty to use the default title “Inventory”.
help.inventory_management: Manage stock, minimum stock and groups for each inventory list.
help.inventory_restock_transfer: Transfer inventory withdrawals to a shopping list according to the selected rule.
help.initial_mode_state: Sets the initial mode selection until a state for this card and list combination has been saved in the browser.
help.completed_item_placement: Controls whether completed items stay in their original position, appear together at the end or are hidden.
help.todo_add_button: Shows the Add button. Enter still works.
help.inventory_quick_entries: Shows or hides the quick entries available for this inventory.
help.disabled_destinations: Disabled destinations remain saved but are not used.
help.list_type_immutable: The list type is set when the list is created and cannot be changed later.
help.scanner_mac_address: The address matches the MAC address from the event
help.chip_next_weekday: The due date is set to the next selected weekday. If the chip is used on that weekday, it means the same weekday of the following week.
help.history_source_entity: The Home Assistant entity logged in the entity inventory.
help.global_todo_templates: These task templates are available in all to-do lists. They cannot be moved to shopping or inventory lists.
help.inventory_type_chips: These chips are available in all inventory lists where list-type chips are enabled.
help.inventory_restock_settings: These settings apply to the selected inventory list. Manual shortage checks also remain available directly in the inventory card.
help.inventory_categories_scope: These categories apply only to this inventory list.
help.shopping_type_categories: These categories are available to all shopping lists where list-type categories are enabled.
help.todo_type_labels: These labels are available to all task lists where list-type labels are enabled.
help.global_labels_scope: These labels are available to all lists where global labels are enabled.
help.inventory_chip_important: This chip can be marked as important for this inventory.
help.share_destination: This destination appears in the Share button selection.
help.scanner_simulation_persistent: You can still use the simulation permanently for testing.
help.todo_local_templates: This list’s own templates are always available. Global item chips are never shown in to-do lists.
help.inventory_group_membership: An item can belong to only one group. Selecting an item that is already grouped requires confirmation to move it. If its previous group then has fewer than two members, that group is dissolved.
help.delivery_list_assignments: A destination can be assigned to multiple shopping and task lists. Inventory lists are excluded for now until a compact delivery format is defined for them.
help.inventory_category_link: A saved category is linked. A new name remains as a dynamic category in this inventory and can later be saved permanently in category management.
help.append_product_brand: Dynamically appends the brand to linked database items unless it is already in the product name.
help.title_collapse_card: Allows the entire card to be expanded and collapsed using its title. This setting has no effect with “Only in large view”.
help.auto_browser_chips: Automatically creates a chip in this browser after successfully adding an item, unless a chip for the same name or product already exists. Turning this off keeps saved browser chips but hides them and stops adding new ones.
help.chip_without_due_date: Neither a due date nor a time will be set.
help.todo_pdf_export: Exports the to-do list with categories, descriptions, due dates and status as a PDF.
help.important_chip_color: Sets the highlight color for important chips. Important browser chips also retain a border in the browser chip color.
help.inventory_typing_filter: Filters visible inventory items by name, brand, quantity, EAN and labels while typing.
help.history_axis_zero_padding: Pads labels on the left chart axis with zeros up to the configured number of digits.
help.recipe_quantity_input: For quantities that can be calculated, use a number and a short unit, such as “250 ml”. Keep any additional notes brief.
help.dish_ingredient_selection: Dishes only appear if the dish feature is enabled in the backend list settings for this shopping list. This option opens a selection when you tap a dish. There you can deselect ingredients and change quantities. When disabled, all ingredients are added immediately.
help.initial_browser_state: Applies until a state for this card has been saved in the browser.
help.template_category_layout: Groups templates by their saved task category. Stacked shows expandable rows; side-by-side layouts arrange categories compactly.
help.reset_restock_lock: Releases the lock. Does not transfer any items yet.
help.category_type_sorting: Sort categories for a list type here.
help.history_import_missing: Imports only timestamps that are still missing. Empty date fields use all history still available in Home Assistant.
help.category_scope_priority: This list’s categories are always available. For matching names, the priority is automatically: list, then list type, then global.
help.title_icon: Sets the icon to the left of the title.
help.item_bottom_spacing: Sets the spacing between an item’s content and the divider below it. The default is 10 px. This spacing is retained even when dividers are hidden.
help.task_top_spacing: Sets the spacing between the divider or category row and the next task’s content. The default is 10 px. When dividers are hidden, both values together form the spacing between tasks.
help.important_template_color: Sets the color for the Important group and important templates.
help.todo_base_text_size: Sets the shared base size for task names and categories. Descriptions, due dates, intervals and labels are automatically shown smaller.
help.recipe_checkbox_default: Sets the default selection for the corresponding checkbox in recipe search.
help.initial_product_details: Sets whether product details and labels are visible on first load.
help.initial_task_filter: Sets which tasks are visible by default when loading.
help.remaining_time_refresh: Sets how often only the visible remaining times are recalculated, in seconds. The list is not reloaded and input focus is retained. 60 seconds = 1 minute.
help.scanner_overview: Pending scans, history, devices and simulation in one place.
help.assign_category_products: Assign products from the product database to category “{p0}”. Up to 100 products are shown. Use search to find more products.
help.refresh_openfoodfacts_product: “{p0}” checks the EAN for an existing product, then fetches product data directly from Open Food Facts. Data is only saved when you select “Save”.
help.responsive_card_layout: Adjusts the layout automatically or enforces the wide panel view or compact mobile view.
help.products_independent: Products are stored independently of lists and inventory.
help.tandoor_recipe_search: Search recipes from the connected Tandoor instance and add selected ingredients.
help.scanner_pending_queue: Scans that need review or input appear here.
help.list_type_quick_actions: Also offer quick actions for the current list type.
help.ntfy_delivery: Sends through the installed Ntfy integration.
help.mode_auto_reset: Resets a temporarily selected mode to the initial mode after this time. 0 disables resetting.
help.todo_sorting: Sorts alphabetically, by due date, using drag & drop or by the saved order.
help.backend_defaults: Defaults for new products and other backend features.
help.shopping_product_search: Searches for matching items in the product database while you type.
help.category_rule_lines: Enter one rule per line for “{p0}”. Empty lines and duplicate rules are removed when saving.
help.continuous_shortfall_quantity: Below minimum stock, each further withdrawal sends exactly the quantity withdrawn.
help.category_name_scale: Enlarges or reduces only the category name relative to the general text size. Additional information, quantities and icons continue to follow the general text size. 100% matches the item size.
help.bring_list_link: Links a list from the official Bring! integration. Item names and quantities are synchronized with Bring!; categories and labels remain stored independently in HA List Manager.
help.linked_product_defaults: Linked products use their current name and category when added. Free-form items use the normal naming rules.
help.template_category_color: Uses each category’s color for the templates displayed in it.
help.active_inventory_target: Uses the enabled inventory card first. If no card is enabled, the default destination from settings applies.
help.inventory_dynamic_category: Select a saved category or enter a new name. A new name is saved as a dynamic category only in this inventory and can later be saved permanently in category management.
help.manage_list_categories: Choose a list and manage its own categories.
help.create_group_minimum: Select at least 2 items to create a group.
help.list_sensor_selection: Selects the list sensor provided by HA List Manager.
help.title_due_warning: Shows a warning at the title when at least one task is due or overdue.
help.shopping_type_chip_color: Used for chips of the Shopping list list type.
help.inventory_local_chip_color: Used for chips that apply only to this inventory.
help.dish_default_color: Used for dishes without their own color. A color saved directly on the dish takes priority.
help.default_inventory_target: Used when no inventory card is enabled as a destination. Scanners with a fixed assignment ignore this default destination.
help.important_templates: Shows templates marked as important first, or additionally in “Important” when grouping is enabled. Hold a template to change this marking for this list.
help.inventory_input_position: Shows the item field and transaction button above or below the inventory.
help.restock_once_flag: Shows a small flag in the existing action row for a one-time fixed restock. The flag does not change the row height or divider position.
help.template_typing_filter: While typing, shows only templates whose names contain the entered text. The task field keeps focus.
help.hidden_items_toggle: Shows the button for showing and hiding hidden items.
help.shopping_add_button: Shows the Add button next to the input row. Adding with Enter remains available.
help.inventory_product_database_access: Shows access to the product database in the card header or three-dot menu.
help.inventory_toolbar_position: Shows the toolbar above or below the inventory.
help.inventory_category_multiselect: Shows the multiple selection for filtering by category.
help.category_next_due: Shows a category’s next future due date.
help.category_task_counts: Shows the number of open tasks and the total count in the category header.
help.delete_completed_tasks_button: Shows a button to delete all completed tasks with a confirmation prompt.
help.shopping_pdf_button: Shows a button in the card header that downloads the complete shopping list with categories, quantities and clickable checkboxes as a PDF.
help.expand_all_categories_button: Shows a toolbar button to expand and collapse all visible categories together.
help.recipe_search_settings: Shows recipe search in the shopping card. The address and API token are stored centrally under Settings.
help.shopping_product_images: Shows product images or a placeholder on items and in product suggestions.
help.todo_template_input_button: Shows a small template button on the right of the task field. It opens all available templates, even when the side display is hidden.
help.inventory_product_suggestions: Shows matching products from the product database while you type.
help.central_dishes: Central dishes can be enabled in regular shopping lists and used there as quick entries.
help.connect_points: Connects this entity’s data points with lines. When disabled, only the individual point symbols remain visible.
help.daily_interval_warning: Tasks with a daily interval are marked as due soon within this period. Enter minutes: 60 = 1 hour, 1,440 = 1 day, 10,080 = 1 week.
help.manual_restock_locks: Active restock locks also apply here. With “Fixed quantity”, a successful manual transfer sets the lock again. The quantity already on the shopping list is shown for information only and is never deducted.
help.item_chip_scopes: Item chips are only available in shopping and inventory lists. Chips with the same name are resolved in this order: list → list type → general items.
help.list_todo_templates: Task templates for this to-do list only.
help.inventory_chip_placement: Automatic places chips on the right in panel and large views, otherwise below the inventory. On narrow cards, they always appear below.
help.backend_todo_features: Backend to-do list with due dates, recurrence and filters
help.recipe_search_limit: Limits results per search. The default is 100 recipes.
help.fixed_restock_trigger: When stock first falls below the minimum, the default quantity or the custom quantity for the item or group is sent once. A minimum stock level must be set for the item or group. Further removals are locked until stock is added, manually changed or the lock is reset.
help.series_label: Name for this data series in the legend and list. If left blank, the Home Assistant name is used.
help.series_icon_override: Overrides the icon for this data series.
help.series_color: Sets the icon and chart line color for this data series.
help.completed_task_placement: Controls whether completed tasks appear in place, together at the end or are hidden.
help.inventory_quantity_input: Shows the quantity field in the input row. Without it, each action processes one item.
help.task_input_visibility: Shows or hides the input for new tasks.
help.search_completed_items: Temporarily shows completed items again when they match a search.
help.chip_color_modes: “Chip color, otherwise Global/Shopping list/This list” uses the color saved on the permanent chip first and only falls back to one of the three card colors if the chip has no color. “Always Global/Shopping list/This list” ignores saved chip colors. “Saved chip colors only” leaves permanent chips without their own color neutral. “No colors” displays all chips neutrally. In the first three modes, browser chips always use the browser chip color set below.
help.chip_purpose: Chips let you add frequently needed items later with a single click.
help.include_list_type_definitions: Also offer definitions for the current list type.
help.label_scope: The scope determines which lists offer and display the label. Existing assignments are retained when the scope changes.
help.minimum_stock: The minimum stock level identifies items that should be replenished.
help.chip_name: The name is required and stays unchanged. If you select a product first, its current name is filled in automatically. You can then change it to use as the chip label.
help.due_date_offset: Clicking advances the due date by the selected interval in hours, days or months. An optional time then sets the time of day.
help.inventory_category_local: The selected category applies only to this inventory entry.
help.central_product_editing: Product data is managed centrally. After adding a product, you can change all its details using “Edit item”.
help.task_recurrence: Recurrence determines the interval after completion at which the next due date is created. Leave blank for no recurrence.
help.general_item_chip_availability: These general item chips are only available in shopping and inventory lists. To-do lists use separate templates.
help.automatic_restock_quantity_only: This applies to automatic restocking, for example 6 items. It is not used as the quantity here.
help.dynamic_categories: These categories come from existing list items and have not been saved permanently yet.
help.inventory_type_categories: These categories are available to all inventory lists with list type categories enabled.
help.shopping_type_labels: These labels are available to all shopping lists with list type labels enabled.
help.inherited_category_order: This list currently uses the global base order, followed by its own categories. A combined custom order is only created when you save.
help.automatic_manual_restock_quantity: This quantity is sent automatically once for {p0} when stock falls below the minimum. Manual shortage transfers use minimum minus stock instead.
help.group_overrides_item_restock: This item belongs to the group “{p0}”. The group’s restock rule applies while it remains grouped. This individual rule stays saved and applies again after the group is dissolved.
help.list_content_always_active: This list’s own content is always active. Changes to other scopes are confirmed before saving.
help.single_group_membership: An item can only belong to one group. You must confirm a move before saving. If the previous group then has fewer than two members, it will be dissolved.
help.assignment_rules_per_line: One rule per line. You can edit the rules later on the category details page.
help.append_linked_package_quantity: Dynamically appends the package quantity for linked database products.
help.card_collapse_control: Allows expanding and collapsing using the title or arrow.
help.list_filter_persistence: Allows a temporary filter or saves it for this list in this browser.
help.browser_chips_database_products: Also creates browser chips for database products. By default, browser chips are only created for free-form list items without a product link.
help.inventory_database_browser_chips: Creates browser chips for database products after successful inventory actions. Disabled by default.
help.important_browser_chip_color: Sets the highlight color for important chips. Important browser chips also retain a border in the browser chip color.
help.filter_while_typing_item: Filters visible list items as you type in the item field.
help.decimal_zero_padding: Pads values with zeros to the configured number of decimal places. With two decimal places, for example, 1.5 becomes 1.50.
help.fixed_restock_minimum_required: “Fixed quantity below minimum” requires a minimum stock level. Without it, there is no threshold, so nothing is sent automatically.
help.scope_priority: Each list automatically uses this priority: list before list type before global. Dynamic categories for individual items are unaffected.
help.include_shared_todo_templates: Also offer shared task templates for to-do lists.
help.open_saved_pages: Open saved pages and tabs directly.
help.label_scope_priority: Labels with the same name are combined. Priority increases from left to right: Global → Shopping lists → This list.
help.central_category_order: Manage base orders centrally and override them per list only when needed.
help.sort_own_categories: Only this list’s own categories are sorted here. The global base order remains unchanged.
help.bring_quantity_examples: In Bring!, this becomes “2 x 250 ml”, for example. “250 ml”, “2 x 250 ml” and “2 x Organic, mild” are also recognized correctly.
help.default_fixed_restock_quantity: If a default quantity is entered, it applies to items and groups that use the list default. If left blank, each item or group that needs automatic restocking must have its own fixed quantity; otherwise it will not be restocked automatically.
help.transfer_every_removal: Each successful removal is transferred regardless of the minimum stock level.
help.category_chip_layout: “No category chips” shows the normal quick entries. “Stacked” shows each category on its own row. The two “Side by side” variants arrange categories compactly with automatic line wrapping; the content opens on its own row directly after the selected category. The compact variant omits the count and expand arrow.
help.manage_category_products: Click the icon or name to manage the category’s automatic and fixed product assignments. The pencil opens the full category editor.
help.additional_recipe_units: Comma-separated and case-insensitive. The built-in units EL (tbsp), TL (tsp), Prise (pinch), Messerspitze (knife tip) and Schuss (dash) do not need to be repeated here.
help.show_global_labels: Show labels created for all lists.
help.label_purpose: Labels complement categories with multiple tags that can be freely combined.
help.imported_hourly_statistics: Historical values imported from Home Assistant long-term statistics each summarize one hour. The mean is used, falling back to state or sum; the original individual readings cannot be recovered from these values.
help.task_bottom_spacing: Sets the spacing between a task’s content and the divider below it. The default is 10 px.

legacy_import.intro: Copy lists from the original card into new HA List Manager lists: shopping, to-do or inventory.

legacy_import.apply_help: A database backup is created before import. Importing does not trigger scripts, notifications or replenishment.
legacy_import.result_help: The source lists remain unchanged. Add the new cards to a dashboard using the YAML below.
legacy_import.copy_failed: Copying was not possible. Select and copy the YAML text.
legacy_import.expires_help: This check expires after 20 minutes. A Home Assistant restart also clears it. Read the YAML again afterwards.
legacy_import.no_entries_help: Creates empty lists with categories and configured chips. A separately selected EAN database can still be imported into the central product database.
legacy_import.inventory_help: Without EAN import, stock creates simple new products. Entries with the same name and category are combined. Variant groups, minimum stock and automatic replenishment are not imported.
legacy_import.warning_group_appearance: Review appearance in the card editor
legacy_import.ean_help: Imports all saved EAN products into the shared product database, also for shopping lists. Existing products with the same EAN are reused without changing their data. Category defaults apply only to the imported inventory list.
legacy_import.inventory_ean_help: Stock is linked to a product by its EAN or a unique name. Ambiguous names need a choice in the preview; quantities are never duplicated.
legacy_import.ean_conflicts_help: Select the intended EAN for each ambiguous inventory entry, or keep it as a generic product. Then check the selection again.
legacy_import.ean_choice_pending: Assignment changed. Check the preview again before importing.
